Folks — forwarding Ana's note and Marcus' acknowledgement. Quick thoughts before we draft:

1) Defense/control: we should avoid broad defend/control where the customer attempts to control counsel. Offer defend with reservation — Redwood will take lead on model-output claims that are clearly caused by our model training or proprietary components; for customer-provided prompts/data claims, propose a reimburse-only approach.

2) Evidence handoff: propose a 3-tier routing: (A) Immediate triage artifacts (alerting logs, request/response snippets) retained by Redwood for 90 days; (B) Full prompt+KV cache excerpts for 180 days available on request with audit; (C) Long-term artifacts (model binaries/weights) only retained per deployment agreement (private deployments).

3) SLA and notice: propose 5 business days for receipt acknowledgement, 20 business days for initial substantive response (triage + evidence capture plan).

I'll draft the straw doc tonight and try to incorporate sample language for an Order Form addendum that limits defend/control to a narrow scenario. Rishi — can you run an insurance-offset check (whether we can pass through costs if our insurer contributes)?

-Kim
Kimberly Park

Subject: Proposed hybrid defense model & evidence routing (draft)

Ana / procurement team — attached is Redwood's straw proposal; high-level summary below and included as tracked changes in the attached doc (GigaHealth_MSA_Redline_v3.docx):

Summary of proposed hybrid defense model:
- Model-output third-party IP claims: Redwood to "defend then indemnify" where claim is causally linked to Redwood-owned model artifacts or training data; we retain right to select counsel and manage defense.
- Customer-provided prompt/data claims: Customer to defend and indemnify; Redwood will assist with evidence collection and preservation on a reimbursable basis.
- Mutual defense for mixed-cause claims with pre-defined evidence thresholds and cost-sharing waterfall.

Evidence routing (see Evidence_Routing_Map_v2.pdf):
- Incident notice: customer provides claim notice to legal@redwood.ai and support@redwood.ai.
- Redwood commits to immediate ephemeral log capture (first 30 days) and a 90-day retention tier for triage artifacts.
- For expanded evidence requests (full prompt history, KV cache), Redwood will produce under a narrow TOU/Evidence addendum; longer retention requires Order Form opt-in.

Next steps: please review and tell us if you prefer a defend/control or reimburse-first approach for model-output claims. We can also turn this into specific redline language for the MSA/order form if procurement/legal wants.

Regards,
Marcus Lin
Head of Legal Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: GigaHealth_MSA_Redline_v3.docx (updated with our straw), Evidence_Routing_Map_v2.pdf
